name: Code Review
description: Two agents review the same code in parallel (bugs vs security), then a third synthesizes a final verdict.
notes: Pass source code or a git diff as --input. Works best with a code-optimised model (e.g. Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct). Requires at least 2 agents.

steps.label: bugs
steps.data:
